_about: Per-task fields for botfails_benchmark/prompts.py, written from the normal_train instruction (meta/tasks.jsonl) and normal training frames of camera logitech_1 only. checks: scene questions asked at a DINO alarm in the listed phases; holds = answers meaning the sub-goal holds. Left/right are as seen in the image (the camera faces the robot).
_selection: A check is used only if it falsely fails at most 1 of 12 random normal training frames per phase (prompt checks v1-v3, see botfails_benchmark/README.md and evaluation/FIDeL/README.md). No VLM hold question: the gripper signal already says that an object is held, and every hold wording failed on 1-12 of 12 normal frames from this far camera. Tasks without an accepted check (buttons: top of the box not visible; screws: screws too small) have checks [] and fallback 'dino'.

domotic_dishTidyUp.instruction: store dishes in a dish rack

checks.name: plate_flat
checks.question: Look at the metal dish rack. Does a plate lie flat in it instead of standing upright?

checks.name: dish_beside_rack
checks.question: Does a dish lie on its side next to the dish rack?

domotic_groceriesSorting.instruction: sorting groceries, vegetables in the box with a pink sign and sweets in the box with the yellow sign

checks.name: sweet_in_pink
checks.question: Is there a sweet, such as chocolate, a biscuit or a donut, in the clear box with the pink sign?

checks.name: produce_in_yellow
checks.question: Is there a fruit or a vegetable in the clear box with the yellow-green sign?

domotic_makingCoffee.instruction: making coffee: take some coffee powder with the spoon and pour it into the filter of the coffee machine

checks.name: powder
checks.question: Is there coffee powder on the table or on the outside of the coffee machine?

checks.name: spill
checks.question: Is there coffee on the table outside the glasses and the jug?

domotic_setTheTable.instruction: Set the table: one glass, one plate, one fork and one knife. Fork on the left of the plate and knife on the right

checks.name: cutlery
checks.lead: Look at the green plate in the middle of the table, as seen in this image. Which describes it?
checks.A: The pink fork lies to the right of the plate or is not next to it yet, and the orange knife lies to the left of the plate or is not next to it yet
checks.B: The pink fork lies to the left of the plate, or the orange knife lies to the right of the plate
checks.C: No green plate is in the middle of the table

domotic_vegetablesAndFruitsSorting.instruction: sorting fruits and vegetables, put vegetables in the box with a yellow mark and fruits in the box with a pink mark

checks.name: fruit_in_yellow
checks.question: Is a banana, grapes, an apple, a lemon, an orange or a strawberry in the clear box with the yellow-green mark?

checks.name: vegetable_in_pink
checks.question: Is corn, broccoli, a pepper, a cucumber or lettuce in the clear box with the pink mark?

industrial_robothon_buttons.instruction: push the red button then move the slider to the top and push the blue button

industrial_robothon_hatchAndProbe.instruction: open the hatch, grab the probe, measure tension, place the probe in the black plug, close the hatch

checks.A: Its tip is in the black socket on the black box
checks.B: Its tip is in a red socket or in another hole of the black box
checks.C: It hangs from its stand or is not in any socket

industrial_soldering.instruction: soldering a part on an electronic board

checks.name: iron
checks.C: Held by the red robot gripper
